bills.title: Foreign Investment Reform (Protecting Australia’s National Security) Bill 2020

name: The majority voted against [amendments](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/r6614) introduced by Pauline Hanson's One Nation Party on [Australia's water entitlement](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr6614_amend_2e3fe7c1-aeed-490c-a88d-0283593a0efe%22;rec=0), a [benefit to Australia](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr6614_amend_20ef88b1-1c4e-4a60-83f9-71abda3893bb%22;rec=0) test and the [publication of the Register](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fr6614_amend_21842ba6-8690-4e9c-9391-bfcfb08267f5%22;rec=0). This means the amendments failed.
